main_text.p: regia, quae si regiam menſa digna, ſolentſ prima fere menſa apponi elixa, eque ſinapis intinſlu eduntur magna gula aviditate & irritamenſto: varius aſſantur, praeter enim coſlas ex toto bove verubus nihil torreri ſolet, que inter elegantiores eſcas hiemis reponuntur a quibusſ dam, ſalviaque confixa expetuntur: crebrius eduntur ex condimento atro, vini aceto, mo-

mento, ſale ac pipere concinnato. Lautiores piperatum condimentum vocant. Caterum laniarum fraus & dolus hic detegenda mor-boſ ſepe bones mactantium, quos tamen ma-Circa bubulá carnem clare in ampliori bus urbibus lege cautum eſt. Cognoscuntur autem morboſ, cum fœno aut pabulo objecto abstinent, quo neglecto certum eſt magnas ſepe clades veſcentibus accidiſſe, praeſertim cum deprehenſum ſit, tabe pulmonis, morbisſ, alias pene confectos jugulatos eſſe, ini cibos admiffos, carnibus ſilicet ſale alendo fa-multitudo aſſervatis. Qua avaritia quid quaque peſtilentius? vitiatam enim carnem vitio-ſos humores ac ſanguinem generare non veriſ-mile, ſed veriſſimum eſt. Idem qui ſilicet ad cultrum boves emunt, non conſiderant, qua reiruptice & paſtoritie periti examinant, sitem ſilicet calorem & nutricatum, tantumſ ſi pinguet ſint & habitori corpore, pragrandi-bus enim amplius, dignitas, & laus maxima, cumjusmodi nobilissima graminofiſimaq, regiones alunt, perá univerſum fere Germaniae orbem alti-

page.notes: Two-column page with a left marginal column of short fragments (ran as "Circa bubulá carnem" and other side words; these are marginal notes beside the text, so they are fragmentary and partly illegible in this scan). The lower part of the page is faint and the final lines are cut off at the foot. Several words are uncertain due to the faint print and show-through from the other side; long s is rendered as plain s per the convention, and some words are marked where doubtful. Some margin words beside "quid pr\u00e6", "cipue ob", "feruan-", "dum vit\u00e6", "proroga-" and "tori?" are too faint to read reliably and are not fully transcribed.
